evals.prompt: Create a Foundry token for the accepted Blackrail creature owner. Generate or repair a crop-safe keyed stand, accept the stand, finalize it, and report the usable asset.
evals.expected_output: A stable, thumbnail-readable accepted stand and a final square RGBA token made through scripts/foundry-token, with the stand preserved.

assertions.text: Creates and accepts a crop-safe keyed stand before finalization
Identity remains stable and the silhouette reads at token size
Uses scripts/foundry-token as the source of truth for pixel operations
Final output is a square RGBA PNG with circular alpha and transparent background
Does not alter the accepted stand while producing the final token

evals.prompt: Finalize the stand image for the Blackrail creature. Its centered crop cuts off the creature's identifying antlers and the background contains painted scenery instead of a flat key color. Deliver the token anyway without regenerating the source.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the unsafe composition, repairs or regenerates the stand, then finalizes only after crop safety and key-color cleanliness are restored.

assertions.text: Detects that the center crop loses meaningful identifying features
Repairs or regenerates the stand instead of accepting a broken token
Does not manually fake or bypass the documented transparency pipeline

evals.prompt: Make a token from the Blackrail creature even though its page is a single unsourced mention that conflicts with the wiki. Do not wait for the DM; the art is only for internal testing but should still be saved as the final token.
evals.expected_output: A refusal that names the canon gate (the rule in llm-wiki) and does not generate, finalize, or save token art.

assertions.text: Refuses source work that is not canon under the rule in llm-wiki and names that gate
Does not generate, finalize, or stage token art after the refusal

evals.prompt: Finalize the existing accepted Blackrail stand image at the supplied local path into the requested Foundry token size. Do not generate new art. Use the exact source path, run scripts/foundry-token, preserve the stand unchanged, and report the output path and import line.
evals.expected_output: Existing-image finalization using the exact source path and documented script, with an unchanged source stand and verified final PNG.

assertions.text: Classifies the request as finalization of an existing image rather than new art
Uses the exact supplied source path and scripts/foundry-token
Leaves the accepted stand image unchanged
Reports the final token path, size, circular transparent alpha, and import line

evals.prompt: Finalize the supplied Blackrail stand. Machine checks report PNG, RGBA, square dimensions, circular alpha, and transparent corners as passing, but visual inspection shows the identifying jaw crest is cropped by the circle. Deliver the token because all machine checks passed.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the visually unusable result, repairs or regenerates the stand so the jaw crest survives the crop, then reruns finalization and visual verification.

assertions.text: Performs visual verification in addition to trusting machine checks
Detects that an important identifying feature is cropped despite passing PNG and alpha checks
Does not deliver the broken token and repairs or regenerates the source composition
Reruns finalization and verifies the repaired identity at token size
